PLAYTIME-TRACKER.name: Playtime Tracker
PLAYTIME-TRACKER.description: Tracks the total connected playtime of every user in the world.
PLAYTIME-TRACKER.title: Chronicle of Time
PLAYTIME-TRACKER.subtitle: A record of time spent within this world.
PLAYTIME-TRACKER.resetWarning: This will permanently reset every user's accumulated playtime to zero. Players currently online will begin counting again from the moment of the reset.
PLAYTIME-TRACKER.resetGMOnly: Only a GM can reset playtime.
PLAYTIME-TRACKER.resetPrimaryGMOnly: Only the active GM can reset playtime.
PLAYTIME-TRACKER.error.dialog: Unable to open the Playtime Tracker.
